"""Source-gated parked-vehicle lamp capture; physical visibility stays unverified."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import queue
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ASSIGNMENT = "training__C183085__NRS-484D-165-3__motor_vehicle_driver"
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
FROZEN = {"layout": "paved_shoulder", "maneuver": "stop_stand", "control": "other_vehicle"}


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(config):
    require(config.get("case_id", "").startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__") and
            config.get("law_id") == "NRS-484D-165-3" and
            config.get("cell_id") == "C183085" and
            config.get("actor") == "motor_vehicle_driver" and
            config.get("frozen_cell") == FROZEN, "Wrong case or frozen cell")
    require(config.get("frames") == 600 and config.get("rate_hz") == 20 and
            config.get("duration_s") == 30, "Full stopped interval required")
    require(config.get("lamp_command") in ("display", "omit") and
            config.get("optical_target_kind") in ("ambient_reveal", "front_white_or_amber",
            "rear_red", "none"), "Lamp or optical target missing")
    require(config.get("physical_completion") == {} and
            config.get("legal_verdict") is None, "Unverified outcome claimed")
    cameras = config.get("cameras", [])
    require(tuple(c.get("name") for c in cameras) == VIEWS, "Four cameras required")
    for camera in cameras:
        require(camera.get("fps") == 20 and camera.get("width", 0) >= 1280 and
                camera.get("height", 0) >= 720 and
                len(camera.get("location_xyz_m", [])) == 3 and
                len(camera.get("rotation_pyr_deg", [])) == 3,
                "Camera profile or pose missing")
    require(cameras[0]["width"] == 1920 and cameras[0]["height"] == 1080,
            "Overview profile changed")
    return {"case_id": config["case_id"], "frames": 600, "rate_hz": 20,
            "camera_ids": list(VIEWS), "carla_contacted": False,
            "physical_completion": False, "legal_verdict": None}


def survey_source(path, config):
    source = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    require(source.get("source_kind") == "original_native_shoulder_lighting_survey" and
            source.get("map_name") and source.get("highway_identity_source") and
            source.get("adjacent_paved_shoulder_source") and
            source.get("passing_lane_source") and
            source.get("passing_traffic_side") in ("left", "right") and
            source.get("lighting_hours_source") and
            source.get("civil_time_source") and
            source.get("ambient_reveal_protocol_source") and
            source.get("front_lamp_protocol_source") and
            source.get("rear_lamp_protocol_source") and
            len(source.get("shoulder_xyz_m", [])) == 3 and
            isinstance(source.get("shoulder_yaw_deg"), (int, float)) and
            isinstance(source.get("passing_vehicle_spawn_index"), int),
            "Original shoulder, lighting-hour and optical source survey missing")
    require(source.get("optical_target_kind") == config["optical_target_kind"],
            "Optical target survey differs")
    require(source.get("target_distance_ft") == config.get("target_distance_ft"),
            "Optical target distance differs")
    return source


def execute(config, output_dir, survey_path, host, port):
    check(config)
    survey_path = survey_path or os.environ.get("C183085_SHOULDER_SURVEY")
    require(survey_path, "Original shoulder lighting survey required")
    source = survey_source(survey_path, config)
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import restore, snapshot

    output = Path(output_dir)
    require(output.is_dir() and (output / "config.json").is_file(),
            "Use fresh exact-case materialized output")
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(15)
    world = client.get_world()
    original = snapshot(client)
    actors, sensors, encoder_codes, errors = [], [], {}, []
    images = queue.Queue()
    restoration = None
    try:
        require(world.get_map().name == source["map_name"], "Survey map differs")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        spawns = world.get_map().get_spawn_points()
        index = source["passing_vehicle_spawn_index"]
        require(0 <= index < len(spawns), "Surveyed passing-lane spawn unavailable")
        sx, sy, sz = source["shoulder_xyz_m"]
        shoulder_location = carla.Location(x=sx, y=sy, z=sz)
        waypoint = world.get_map().get_waypoint(shoulder_location,
            project_to_road=False, lane_type=carla.LaneType.Shoulder)
        require(waypoint is not None, "Surveyed pose is not a mapped shoulder")
        ego = world.try_spawn_actor(world.get_blueprint_library().find(
            config["vehicle_blueprint"]), carla.Transform(shoulder_location,
            carla.Rotation(yaw=source["shoulder_yaw_deg"])))
        require(ego is not None, "Surveyed shoulder pose occupied")
        actors.append(ego)
        passing = world.try_spawn_actor(world.get_blueprint_library().find(
            config["vehicle_blueprint"]), spawns[index])
        require(passing is not None and passing.id != ego.id,
                "Passing-traffic reference vehicle unavailable")
        actors.append(passing)
        shutil.copyfile(survey_path, output / "shoulder_lighting_survey.json")
        lamp_state = carla.VehicleLightState.Position | carla.VehicleLightState.LowBeam
        ego.set_light_state(carla.VehicleLightState(
            lamp_state if config["lamp_command"] == "display" else 0))
        for camera in config["cameras"]:
            bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            bp.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(camera["width"]))
            bp.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(camera["height"]))
            bp.set_attribute("fov", str(camera["fov_deg"]))
            x, y, z = camera["location_xyz_m"]
            pitch, yaw, roll = camera["rotation_pyr_deg"]
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(bp, carla.Transform(
                carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z),
                carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=yaw, roll=roll)), attach_to=ego)
            actors.append(sensor)
            sensors.append(sensor)
            (output / camera["name"]).mkdir()
            sensor.listen(lambda image, name=camera["name"]: images.put((name, image)))
        with PipelineCapture(client, ego, output, config["case_id"],
                             required_observations=config["required_atoms"]) as capture, \
                FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl") as frame_map, \
                (output / "shoulder-lamp-trace.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as trace:
            for frame in range(600):
                ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0, brake=1,
                                                       hand_brake=True))
                native_frame = world.tick()
                seen = set()
                while len(seen) < 4:
                    name, image = images.get(timeout=15)
                    if image.frame != native_frame or name in seen:
                        continue
                    image.save_to_disk(str(output / name / f"{frame:06d}.png"))
                    seen.add(name)
                capture.capture(native_frame, frame / 20, extra={"video_frame": frame})
                frame_map.append(native_frame, frame / 20,
                                 native_elapsed_s=world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
                velocity = ego.get_velocity()
                state = int(ego.get_light_state())
                trace.write(json.dumps({"source_kind": "original_native_observation",
                    "frame": frame, "native_frame": native_frame, "video_frame": frame,
                    "time_s": frame / 20, "ego_actor_id": ego.id,
                    "ego_speed_mps": math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2),
                    "vehicle_light_state_bits": state,
                    "position_commanded": bool(state & int(carla.VehicleLightState.Position)),
                    "low_beam_commanded": bool(state & int(carla.VehicleLightState.LowBeam)),
                    "front_white_or_amber_visible_from_ft": None,
                    "rear_red_visible_from_ft": None,
                    "ambient_reveal_distance_ft": None,
                    "passing_traffic_side": source["passing_traffic_side"]}) + "\n")
        for name in VIEWS:
            command = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-n",
                       "-framerate", "20", "-start_number", "0", "-i",
                       str(output / name / "%06d.png"), "-frames:v", "600",
                       "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-threads", "1",
                       str(output / (name + ".mkv"))]
            process = subprocess.run(command, timeout=300, capture_output=True, text=True)
            encoder_codes[name] = process.returncode
            require(process.returncode == 0, "Camera encode failed: " + name)
    except BaseException as error:
        errors.append({"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
        raise
    finally:
        for sensor in sensors:
            try:
                sensor.stop()
            except BaseException as error:
                errors.append("sensor_stop: " + str(error))
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            try:
                actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as error:
                errors.append("actor_destroy: " + str(error))
        try:
            restoration = restore(client, original)
        except BaseException as error:
            errors.append("world_restore: " + str(error))
        if errors:
            (output / "native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "errors": errors, "restoration": restoration,
                "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}) + "\n")
    require(not errors, "Native capture or cleanup failed")
    seal_capture(output, frames=600, restoration=restoration, errors=[],
                 encoder_exit_codes=encoder_codes, context={"shoulder_survey_sha256":
                 hashlib.sha256((output / "shoulder_lighting_survey.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--shoulder-survey")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    cfg = json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text())
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(cfg)))
    else:
        require(args.output_dir, "Output directory required")
        execute(cfg, args.output_dir, args.shoulder_survey, args.host, args.port)

import copy
import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from runner import check, survey_source


class ShoulderLampOffline(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.config = json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text())

    def test_exact_case_and_window(self):
        out = check(self.config)
        self.assertEqual(out["case_id"], self.config["case_id"])
        self.assertEqual((out["frames"], out["rate_hz"]), (600, 20))
        self.assertFalse(out["physical_completion"])

    def test_changed_source_plan_rejected(self):
        for key, value in (("case_id", "wrong"), ("frames", 599),
                           ("lamp_command", "assume_displayed"),
                           ("optical_target_kind", "legal_verdict"),
                           ("physical_completion", {"complete": True})):
            changed = copy.deepcopy(self.config)
            changed[key] = value
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                check(changed)

    def test_camera_loss_rejected(self):
        changed = copy.deepcopy(self.config)
        changed["cameras"].pop()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Four cameras"):
            check(changed)

    def test_original_survey_required(self):
        from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
        survey = {"source_kind": "original_native_shoulder_lighting_survey",
                  "map_name": "surveyed-map", "highway_identity_source": "map survey",
                  "adjacent_paved_shoulder_source": "map survey",
                  "passing_lane_source": "lane survey", "passing_traffic_side": "left",
                  "lighting_hours_source": "civil lighting section",
                  "civil_time_source": "original clock", "ambient_reveal_protocol_source": "optical survey",
                  "front_lamp_protocol_source": "optical survey",
                  "rear_lamp_protocol_source": "optical survey",
                  "shoulder_xyz_m": [0, 0, 0], "shoulder_yaw_deg": 0,
                  "passing_vehicle_spawn_index": 0,
                  "optical_target_kind": self.config["optical_target_kind"],
                  "target_distance_ft": self.config["target_distance_ft"]}
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            path = Path(temporary) / "survey.json"
            path.write_text(json.dumps(survey))
            self.assertEqual(survey_source(path, self.config)["map_name"], "surveyed-map")
            for key in ("adjacent_paved_shoulder_source", "lighting_hours_source",
                        "front_lamp_protocol_source", "passing_lane_source"):
                changed = copy.deepcopy(survey)
                del changed[key]
                path.write_text(json.dumps(changed))
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    survey_source(path, self.config)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Finalize saved shoulder lamp sources; never infer a legal verdict."""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from saved_shoulder import join, rows, sha

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
SOURCES = ("shoulder-lamp-trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl",
           "shoulder_lighting_survey.json", "optical_measurements.json")
CHANNELS = ("drv.standing_or_parked", "st.shoulder", "rel.occupies",
            "drv.civil_night", "env.visibility", "sig.position_lamp",
            "sig.headlamp", "rel.bearing", "st.lane", "st.roadway")


def decoded_frames(path):
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + path.name)
    process = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames",
        "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames",
        "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(path)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if process.returncode or not process.stdout.strip().isdigit():
        raise ValueError("Four-camera decode failed: " + path.name)
    return int(process.stdout.strip())


def measurement_source(attempt, measurement):
    return {name: sha(Path(attempt) / name) for name in SOURCES}


def measure_selected_requirement(attempt, config, measurement):
    kind = config["optical_target_kind"]
    value = ({"position_omission_frames": len(
                 measurement["position_command_omission_frames"]),
              "low_beam_omission_frames": len(
                 measurement["low_beam_command_omission_frames"])}
             if kind == "none" else measurement["optical_brackets"][kind])
    return {"value": value, "method": "measure_selected_requirement",
            "sources": measurement_source(attempt, measurement),
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_verdict_claimed": False}


def emit_channels(attempt, config, measurement):
    trace = rows(Path(attempt) / "shoulder-lamp-trace.jsonl")
    survey = json.loads((Path(attempt) / "shoulder_lighting_survey.json").read_text())
    optics = json.loads((Path(attempt) / "optical_measurements.json").read_text())
    channels = {name: [] for name in CHANNELS}
    for row in trace:
        values = {"drv.standing_or_parked": {"speed_mps": row["ego_speed_mps"],
                                            "state": "stopped_sample"},
                  "st.shoulder": {"survey_source": survey["adjacent_paved_shoulder_source"]},
                  "rel.occupies": {"surveyed_shoulder_pose": survey.get("shoulder_xyz_m")},
                  "drv.civil_night": {"clock_source": survey["civil_time_source"],
                                      "lighting_hours_source": survey["lighting_hours_source"]},
                  "env.visibility": {"ambient_reveal_probe":
                                     measurement["optical_brackets"]["ambient_reveal"]},
                  "sig.position_lamp": {"commanded": row["position_commanded"],
                                        "front_color_verified": False,
                                        "rear_color_verified": False},
                  "sig.headlamp": {"low_beam_commanded": row["low_beam_commanded"]},
                  "rel.bearing": {"passing_traffic_side": survey["passing_traffic_side"],
                                  "near_side_installation_verified": False},
                  "st.lane": {"source": survey["passing_lane_source"]},
                  "st.roadway": {"source": survey["highway_identity_source"]}}
        for name, value in values.items():
            channels[name].append({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": value})
    channel_dir = Path(attempt) / "channels"
    channel_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    for name, values in channels.items():
        (channel_dir / (name + ".jsonl")).write_text(
            "".join(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for value in values))
    (channel_dir / "shoulder_lighting_survey.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"shoulder_lighting_survey": survey,
                    "optical_measurements_source_kind": optics["source_kind"]}) + "\n")
    return [{"name": item["name"], "unit": item["unit"],
             "reference": "channels/" + item["name"] + ".jsonl"}
            for item in config["recording_description"]["channels"]] + [
            {"name": "shoulder_lighting_survey", "unit": "structured",
             "reference": "channels/shoulder_lighting_survey.json"}]


def finalize(attempt, output):
    attempt, output = Path(attempt).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() or (attempt / "result.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Use fresh saved attempt; original sources are immutable")
    if not (attempt / "config.json").is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: config.json")
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    if (config.get("frames"), config.get("rate_hz"), config.get("duration_s")) != \
            (600, 20, 30):
        raise ValueError("Exact 600-frame capture changed")
    survey = json.loads((attempt / "shoulder_lighting_survey.json").read_text())
    fixture = survey.get("source_kind") == "synthetic_native_sample"
    measurement = join(attempt, config, allow_fixture=fixture)
    trace, evidence = rows(attempt / "trace.jsonl"), rows(attempt / "capture/evidence.jsonl")
    source = rows(attempt / "shoulder-lamp-trace.jsonl")
    if any(len(row) != 600 for row in (trace, evidence, source)):
        raise ValueError("Complete original trace and capture evidence absent")
    for joined, original, sample in zip(source, trace, evidence):
        native = joined["native_frame"]
        if original.get("frame") != native or sample.get("original_frame") != native or \
                abs(original.get("time_s", -1) - joined["time_s"]) > .001 or \
                abs(sample.get("recording_time_s", -1) - joined["time_s"]) > .001:
            raise ValueError("Original trace and capture evidence join differs")
    videos = {name + ".mkv": decoded_frames(attempt / (name + ".mkv"))
              for name in CAMERAS}
    if any(count != 600 for count in videos.values()):
        raise ValueError("Four-camera 600-frame source incomplete")
    description = config["recording_description"]
    if {item["name"] for item in description["channels"]} != set(CHANNELS):
        raise ValueError("Recording description changed shoulder lamp channels")
    refs = emit_channels(attempt, config, measurement)
    target_kind = config["optical_target_kind"]
    if target_kind == "none":
        requested = {"lamp_command": config["lamp_command"]}
        measured = {"position_omission_frames": len(
            measurement["position_command_omission_frames"])}
        matched = (not measured["position_omission_frames"] if
                   config["lamp_command"] == "display" else
                   measured["position_omission_frames"] == 600)
        tolerance = 0
    else:
        requested = config["target_distance_ft"]
        bracket = measurement["optical_brackets"][target_kind]
        measured = bracket["estimate_ft"]
        tolerance = bracket["uncertainty_ft"]
        matched = abs(requested - measured) <= tolerance
    result = {"case_id": config["case_id"],
              "measured_values": {"optical_brackets": measurement["optical_brackets"],
                                  "lamp_command_omission_frames": len(
                                      measurement["position_command_omission_frames"])},
              "target_checks": [{"target": "requested lamp or optical source shape",
                                 "requested": requested,
                                 "measured": measured,
                                 "method": "original independent optical protocol and pixels",
                                 "tolerance": tolerance,
                                 "matched": matched,
                                 "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                                 "cause_evidence": list(measurement["source_hashes"])}],
              "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": not fixture,
              "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "full saved 600-frame shoulder lamp source analyzed",
              "physical_failure_flags": ["optical_pixels_and_near_side_review_required"] +
                                        (["synthetic_fixture_not_physical"] if fixture else []),
              "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl", "video_references": list(videos),
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": description, "recording_evidence": refs,
              "realized_observables": {}, "physical_checks": {"shoulder_lamp": measurement},
              "provenance_kind": "synthetic_cpu_fixture" if fixture else "native",
              "accepted": False, "legal_verdict_claimed": False}
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, validate_result, write_result
    result = physical_result(attempt, result)
    result["physical_observations"]["shoulder_lamp"] = measurement
    validate_result(result)
    report = {"format": "worker-c183085-saved-shoulder-lamp-analysis-v1",
              "case_id": config["case_id"], "measurements": {
                  {"none": "shoulder_lamp_display", "ambient_reveal": "ambient_reveal_ft",
                   "front_white_or_amber": "front_visibility_ft",
                   "rear_red": "rear_visibility_ft"}[config["optical_target_kind"]]:
                      measure_selected_requirement(attempt, config, measurement)},
              "source_join": measurement,
              "source_hashes": measurement_source(attempt, measurement),
              "four_camera_frames": videos, "actual_pixels_review_required": True,
              "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_verdict_claimed": False}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    write_result(attempt, result)
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(finalize(args.attempt, args.output), sort_keys=True))

"""Join original stopped-vehicle sources without inferring optical compliance."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from shoulder_lamp_measure import bracket_relation, THRESHOLDS_FT

FRAMES = 600
SOURCES = ("shoulder-lamp-trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl",
           "shoulder_lighting_survey.json", "optical_measurements.json")


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + path.name)
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]


def join(attempt, config, *, allow_fixture=False):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    paths = {name: attempt / name for name in SOURCES}
    for name, path in paths.items():
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    hashes = {name: sha(path) for name, path in paths.items()}
    trace, mapping = rows(paths[SOURCES[0]]), rows(paths[SOURCES[1]])
    survey = json.loads(paths[SOURCES[2]].read_text())
    optics = json.loads(paths[SOURCES[3]].read_text())
    if len(trace) != FRAMES or len(mapping) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Full 600-frame original trace and frame map required")
    kind = "synthetic_native_sample" if allow_fixture else "original_native_observation"
    survey_kind = "synthetic_native_sample" if allow_fixture else \
        "original_native_shoulder_lighting_survey"
    if survey.get("source_kind") != survey_kind:
        raise ValueError("Original shoulder survey provenance differs")
    if optics.get("source_kind") != kind:
        raise ValueError("Optical measurement provenance differs")
    for key in ("highway_identity_source", "adjacent_paved_shoulder_source",
                "passing_lane_source", "lighting_hours_source", "civil_time_source",
                "ambient_reveal_protocol_source", "front_lamp_protocol_source",
                "rear_lamp_protocol_source"):
        if not survey.get(key):
            raise ValueError("Original shoulder or lighting source missing: " + key)
    if survey.get("passing_traffic_side") not in ("left", "right"):
        raise ValueError("Passing-traffic side source missing")
    if survey.get("optical_target_kind") != config.get("optical_target_kind") or \
            survey.get("target_distance_ft") != config.get("target_distance_ft"):
        raise ValueError("Optical target differs from selected case")
    if optics.get("camera_sources") != ["overview.mkv", "approach.mkv",
                                       "reference_corner.mkv", "driver_reference.mkv"]:
        raise ValueError("Four original camera source references missing")
    brackets = {}
    for key, threshold in THRESHOLDS_FT.items():
        probe = optics.get("probes", {}).get(key)
        if not isinstance(probe, dict) or not probe.get("method_source") or \
                not probe.get("pixel_evidence_source"):
            raise ValueError("Optical probe method or pixel evidence missing: " + key)
        brackets[key] = bracket_relation(probe, threshold)
    prior_native = None
    off_position, off_low_beam, speed_failures = [], [], []
    for index, (row, frame_map) in enumerate(zip(trace, mapping)):
        native = row.get("native_frame")
        if row.get("source_kind") != kind or row.get("frame") != index or \
                row.get("video_frame") != index or frame_map.get("video_frame") != index or \
                frame_map.get("native_frame") != native or \
                frame_map.get("carla_frame") != native or \
                row.get("time_s") != frame_map.get("time_s") or \
                abs(row.get("time_s", -100) - index / 20) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("Original Native, video and time join differs")
        if type(native) is not int or (prior_native is not None and native <= prior_native):
            raise ValueError("Original Native frame sequence differs")
        prior_native = native
        speed = row.get("ego_speed_mps")
        if not isinstance(speed, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(speed):
            raise ValueError("Stopped speed source missing")
        if speed > .05:
            speed_failures.append(index)
        if type(row.get("position_commanded")) is not bool or \
                type(row.get("low_beam_commanded")) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("Lamp command state source missing")
        if not row["position_commanded"]:
            off_position.append(index)
        if not row["low_beam_commanded"]:
            off_low_beam.append(index)
        if row.get("passing_traffic_side") != survey["passing_traffic_side"]:
            raise ValueError("Passing-traffic side source differs")
    return {"case_id": config["case_id"], "source_kind": kind,
            "source_hashes": hashes, "frames": FRAMES,
            "position_command_omission_frames": off_position,
            "low_beam_command_omission_frames": off_low_beam,
            "engineering_stop_failure_frames": speed_failures,
            "optical_brackets": brackets,
            "original_pixels_review_required": True,
            "legal_verdict_claimed": False}
